annotations.title: Market breadth: how many members take part

description: How many of an index's members take part in its moves, computed from the members themselves: the share of the S&P 500's (or the S&P 400's, the Dow's, or one sector's) members above their 50- and 200-day averages, how many rose and fell, new 52-week highs and lows, how far the typical member is below its high, the average member's return beside the index's own over a day, a month, the year to date and a year, recent sessions' breadth, and by_sector for the eleven sectors.

by_sector.description: S&P 500: the same measures for each of its eleven sectors (reads the Select Sector SPDRs' holdings too).

days.description: Sessions of daily breadth shown, latest last; default 20.

index.description: S&P 500 (default), S&P 400, Dow, or a Select Sector SPDR's ticker (XLK, XLF, XLE...) for breadth inside one sector.

name: market_breadth

outputSchema.description: latest is the breadth on the latest session; returns sets the average member against the index; daily is each recent session; sectors, with by_sector, each sector's breadth.

title: Market breadth: how many members take part
